calibration_provenance.algorithm: finite grid v2: macro condition F1, aggregate F1, precision, conservative blur/motion tie-breaks; one capture per photo/clip; no holdout inputs
calibration_provenance.highlight_rule: engineering saturation guard: mean >245 and highlight clipping >0.95; deterministic/synthetic verification only; no real positive highlight cases in the supplied proxy collection
calibration_provenance.scope: Proxy resubstitution only; no independent validation/holdout or field generalisation proof

laplacian: left+right+up+down-4*center; 1px border omitted; population variance in squared luma units
motion: 1s anchors plus 125ms partners; box-mean 4x4 reduction; 9 textured tiles; centered MAD +/-4px search; densest +/-1px vector neighbourhood; coordinate-wise median; >=5 textured tiles and >=2/3 consensus, residual <=20
preprocessing: Android bounded ARGB_8888 decode; EXIF baked; no upscale; aspect preserved; bilinear downscale; Y=(77R+150G+29B+128)>>8
semantic_framing: unsupported; explicitly outside owner-approved revised Q2 scope
severity: review is an assistance hint, never a probability or competence score

video_preprocessing_paths.comparison_api27_plus: platform scaled RGB retriever, container rotation baked; benchmark comparison only, not the calibrated default
video_preprocessing_paths.default_api26_plus: sequential MediaCodec SDR YUV420; selected-frame nearest-neighbour sampling; explicit limited/full-range colour conversion; container rotation applied exactly once
